supported: The Vela drain-contact physical state is identical between the self-consistent HFS-on and HFS-off states.
The drain electron quasi-Fermi target remains pinned to the applied drain bias in both states.
The approximately 0.10 dex current response is carried by tiny first-layer quasi-Fermi increment changes and balanced contact/internal flux changes, not by a changed contact boundary value.
not_supported: Claiming that the Vela ohmic contact target directly causes the HFS-on/off response.
Claiming Vela/Sentaurus n23 contact-boundary equivalence without an n23 Sentaurus node-state export.
Changing a contact or transport default from this audit.

claim_policy: Identical Vela HFS-on/off contact states exclude a direct contact-boundary response, not a private Sentaurus contact implementation difference.
Contact and internal flux terms must be reported together at the first free-node layer.
Sub-fA relative changes must be accompanied by absolute current and quasi-Fermi increment changes.
No contact, HFS, SG, or solver default may be changed from this diagnostic alone.
